title: Natural and transitive normalized open-refinement arrows
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be an admissible commutative condensed coefficient ring of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. For every scheme $T$ put $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$, where $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ is the pulled-back ring and the category is the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Use the module direct images and inverse images of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback], with the coefficient identifications induced by composition of pullbacks from the point and the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$, $j':U\hookrightarrow Z'$, $j'':U\hookrightarrow Z''$ be quasi-compact open immersions, and let $h:Z'\to Z$, $k:Z''\to Z'$ satisfy $hj'=j$, $kj''=j'$, $h^{-1}(j(U))=j'(U)$, and $k^{-1}(j'(U))=j''(U)$ [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use the exact extension by zero of [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek] on ordinary unbounded derived categories. Let $\eta_j:1\xrightarrow{\sim}j^*j_!$ be its open adjunction unit, and let $r_h$ be [lem-sfb-identity-open-derived-restriction]. For every $K\in D_U$ define $e_{h,K}:j_!K\to Rh_*j'_!K$ to be the adjoint of $(r_h)^{-1}_{j'_!K}\eta_{j',K}$. It is the unique arrow satisfying
$$\eta_{j',K}^{-1}(r_h)_{j'_!K}j^*(e_{h,K})\eta_{j,K}=1_K.$$
These arrows are natural in $K$, $e_{1,K}=1_{j_!K}$ under the canonical identity constraints, and
$$\kappa_{h,k,j''_!K}\circ e_{hk,K}=Rh_*(e_{k,K})\circ e_{h,K},$$
where $\kappa$ is [lem-sfb-module-derived-compositor-coherence]. The assertions hold for all unbounded $K$; they do not assert invertibility of $e_{h,K}$. No properness or density is assumed.
